facts: The Endpoints table enumerates list, retrieve, attach and detach; POST accepts existing property ids and there is explicitly no property-create or property-update operation on this resource.
The opening warning and Detaching section link existing project property create, update and delete operations. The mode warning links the existing workspace attach operation.
Reads return full property definitions rather than join records; pk is the property id. Attach accepts a properties id array; detach removes this type's link and stored values, not the definition.
Changed from v1 explicitly identifies the existing v1 property creation route as historical comparison, not an additional v2 operation.
